description: Free demo. Try free, then pay per call. Pass one Solana token mint and get a real rug-check: riskScore, riskLevel, a one-line verdict, the top risk flags, liquidity, market cap, age, and pump.fun status. Uses free public data only. Cached 60 seconds per mint and rate-limited to 20 calls a minute per client. The paid routes return every flag, the full on-chain checks, and wallet intelligence.
